endpoints.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Sql/servers/{serverName}/disasterRecoveryConfiguration
endpoints.description: Lists a server's disaster recovery configuration.
endpoints.notes: Replace {{AZURE_ACCESS_TOKEN}} with your AZURE ACCESS TOKEN. Replace {{RESOURCEGROUPNAME}} with a real resourcegroupname. Replace {{SERVERNAME}} with a real servername. Replace {{SUBSCRIPTIONID}} with a real subscriptionid.
